sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Galal Essawy, tested by eng. Mostafa 
 Mohamed El Nahal at 06 Feb. 2008, accepted by eng. Ahmed Abd El Rahman Ali 
 general director, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Abouda 
 Elbana, approved by eng. Mahmoud El Naqep: head sector of Ayon Mousa PS..This 
 document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality 
 control general director & MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant: 
 Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control 
 general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
